shortBio.en: Velvet Underground viola/bass/arrangement; later producer/arranger for other artists’ breakthrough LPs.
shortBio.zh: Velvet Underground 中提琴/贝斯/编曲；后为他人突破专集担任制作/编曲。

whyHub.en: VU drone/harmony architect who becomes a mobile producer: method travels off the band logo.
whyHub.zh: VU 持续音/和声架构者，后成为可移动制作人：方法离开乐队 logo 流动。

body.en:
Born 1942, Wales. In early VU, viola drones, piano clusters, and arrangement tension sit beside Reed’s songs (Venus in Furs, Heroin). Leaves 1968 after White Light/White Heat pressure. Solo and production work follows—Nico, The Stooges (as producer credit lore), and later indie/art acts cite his arranging ear.

Hub: first-principles VU noise/harmony, then institutional role as producer outside the band.
body.zh:
1942 年生于威尔士。早期 VU 中，中提琴持续音、钢琴音簇与编曲张力并列 Reed 歌曲（Venus in Furs、Heroin）。White Light/White Heat 压力后 1968 离队。随后独唱与制作——Nico、The Stooges（制作信誉传说）及后期 indie/艺术乐队引用其编曲耳朵。

枢纽：VU 噪声/和声第一性原理，后转为乐队外的制作制度角色。

note.zh: 与 Reed 的创始编曲/持续音时期。

note.en: Solo LPs and producer/arranger credits across scenes.
note.zh: 独唱专集与跨场景制作/编曲署名。
